key_insight: OMatG-FC generates inorganic crystals by learning atomic species and cell volume while keeping structural frameworks fixed, avoiding the need to learn atomic packings.
engineering_relevance: Framework-conditioned generation reduces the search dimensionality for discovering stable materials while allowing unseen structural prototypes derived from known frameworks.
method: Fix fractional atomic coordinates and unit-volume lattice vectors.
Generate atomic species with discrete flow matching and cell-volume scaling with stochastic interpolants.
Identify duplicate frameworks in MP-20 and provide a framework-based dataset split.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art stable, unique, and novel generation rates below the convex hull on LeMat-GenBench using three ML interatomic potentials, without giving numerical results.
watch_item: Fixed frameworks constrain the accessible structural search space, and ML-potential stability estimates require higher-fidelity validation.
